// baseReturnChancePercent: Chance an insured item is RETURNED, by what killed you.
// pmcLevelScaling: Only applies when a PMC killed you AND their level is known. Higher-level PMCs are pickier (take less -> higher return) but extract more reliably; low-level PMCs grab everything but often die with it.
// looterExtractedChancePercent: Chance the killer survived and extracted with your gear. Rolled ONCE per raid, not per item.
// looterDiedBonusPercent: Added to the base chance when the killer did NOT extract. Result is clamped to 0-100.
// traderModifierPercent: Optional per-trader adjustment, added after the above. Prapor / Therapist.
// legacyPackageBehaviour: What to do with insurance packages created before this mod was installed: 'spt' = use SPT's returnChancePercent, or 'other' = treat as the 'other' bucket.
